_notes_space_events: Space jobs, phase 3 (docs/space-jobs-contract.md "Phase 3"; game/sim/Space/SpaceEvents.cs): sites that arrive during the match, and anomalies. This file adds to the space_sites table of maps/sites.json (its kinds list is joined after that file's) and one away table to ship_status. events: after calm_seconds of game time a new event about every every_seconds [min, max] (the gap after each by the system's hash, never sim.Rng), at most max_live event sites in the system at once (a turn with too many is skipped); weights = which kind each event is (by the hash). An event is announced on every player's ship log and is Detected for everyone (a distress call or a sensor alert); identifying it still needs a scan. edge [min, max] = how far from the star moving things come in. generation.anomalies: count [min, max] anomalies rolled with the system after the asteroids (own salt: the other sites stay where they were), drifting drift map units over drift_seconds and then staying. Kinds: rogue_asteroid (rogue: comes in from the edge straight at a body over flight_seconds [min, max] and strikes it then; colony_chance percent of them head for the colony's body when someone has landed there (else a body by the hash, never a belt); push = hold alongside with the tractor for push_seconds [min, max] (by the rock's hash, ÷ the mining lever: Engineering), or an away team plants charges (ship_status table charges: an outcome with deflect turns it); turned aside it veers off veer map units out over veer_seconds and leaves; the ship that turned it gets reward latinum and research [min, max]; a living civilization's world it was heading for: awareness civ_awareness (they were saved quietly), a strike there: civ_strike_awareness; a strike on the colony's body: impact: a spot within spread hexes of a landed player's core (by the hash), every building within radius hexes loses damage [min, max] × (1 − distance ÷ (radius + 1)) condition and every vehicle that much integrity, the max_buildings / max_vehicles nearest only, never below 1 (nothing is destroyed or broken by it); elsewhere a log line). comet (comet: crosses the system from the edge to the far edge over cross_seconds [min, max], passing within pass [min, max] of the star; window [from, to] = the shares of its crossing when its tail is active: "sample" (at the comet, which the ship follows) for sample_seconds while the window is open: hull hull every hull_every_seconds, then research [min, max] and ice [min, max] containers of deuterium ore into the hold (what fits); once per player). lifepods (pods: count [min, max] pods round a point (near a debris field when there is one, near_debris map units off it), each with survivors [min, max] and air for air_seconds [min, max] from the call (by the hash); "pickup" (tractor) takes the pod with the least air left in pickup_seconds, then the next, until none is left; survivors join the crew while it is short, else ride in the hold (3 a container) to be dropped at a station or the colony; a pod whose air runs out is lost; the site is worked out when no pod is left). stranded_ship (stranded: a neutral ship adrift, variants by origin; its air lasts air_seconds [min, max] unless someone restores its power (alongside, then 60 s of Engineering or a patch kit); powered, "escort" makes it follow the flagship (flights × escort_flight) to its destination (a body by the hash, never a belt): arriving in orbit there rescues it: reward latinum and research [min, max]; bait percent of the calls (by the hash) are bait: arriving there springs an ambush: hull ambush_hull [min, max] and one of ambush_systems knocked out (sim.Rng), and the site is spent). anomaly (anomaly: an ion storm; "record_outer" / "record_middle" / "record_inner" holds at that ring (radius: map units from its centre, for the plot) and records: every every_seconds research by the ring, hull loss by the ring, and knock percent that one of systems is knocked out; at most research_cap research per player, then it is worked out; event anomalies last life_seconds [min, max] drifting drift map units, then leave). All numbers are placeholders.
